name: Hologram
author: parrotify
description: The bust as a cloud of glowing points with scanlines; on the beat its slices tear sideways like a broken transmission, the camera cuts every few beats. WebGL; the model needs Parrotify 0.0.9 or newer. Model: "Classical Healer Bust" by Sana Sato (Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0), simplified.
